objective: Close the parser-mismatch bypass of the Pi workflow gate and two smaller gate gaps, in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-launcher (head 58671ec).
scope: Security finding (blocking): workflowRefusal in packages/runtime/src/cli/workflow-check.ts parses the script with acorn sourceType module (about line 820), where <!-- is an operator sequence, but @tintinweb/pi-subagents runs the body with vm.Script as a classic script (src/workflow/worker-source.ts:757 of the package at /home/user/holyagent-notes/pi-probe/node_modules/@tintinweb/pi-subagents), where <!-- and a line-leading --> start HTML-like comments. A script like `let n = 0\nn <!--n; function workflow() { return 1 }\nawait workflow({ scriptPath: "x.js" })` makes the checker see a local workflow function while the runtime calls the package global workflow(), which runs an unchecked script. Fix it in the shared check so the checker and the runtime agree: refuse any script whose source contains <!-- or a --> (the simplest sound rule; scripts have no reason to contain them), and add tests with this exploit and the --> variant. Read the package worker-source.ts and extractMeta to check for any other script-vs-module difference the checker relies on (e.g. top-level await, export handling, strict mode, function declarations at top level) and close each one you find the same way, with a test. The Claude hook uses the same check; refusing these sequences there only makes such a script prompt, which is acceptable.

Code review (non-blocking, ride along): refuseNonSpecialistWorkflow in packages/integrations/pi/src/extension.ts lets a call with both script and name pass; refuse any SubagentWorkflow input key other than script and args, as the Claude hook does, with a test.

Security hardening (non-blocking, ride along): a project .holyagent/config.json with pi.enable false switches both gates off. Make the gates stand down only when pi.enable is off in the user-level config, or when the project value is off and the user value is also off, so a cloned repository cannot turn the gates off; read how the extension collects the config (packages/runtime/src/config) to do it, with a test. Keep the gates on when the config cannot be read.
constraints: Edit only the ownership paths; no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/.
Effect and JSDoc per .claude/CLAUDE.md; the extension runs on Node inside Pi.

Run bunx --no-install mise run build, then bunx --no-install mise run verify; report each exit code (echo $?) and counts, and confirm the Claude dist agents and skills are unchanged.
Write the source diff (excluding the dist bundles) to /home/user/holyagent-notes/launcher-h.diff and give it as diff-file evidence.
Start each evidence line with the criterion text, then a colon.
